metaTitle: Sliding Glass Door Repair Davie FL | Grit, Pools and Locks
description: Sliding glass door repair in Davie: grit in inland tracks, doors on manufactured homes, pool door alarms and locks, and HVHZ rules for a new door.
h1: Sliding glass door repair in Davie
subline: Davie is inland horse country, so its sliders wear from grit and daily use more than salt, and many open onto a pool.
answer: Sliding glass door repair in Davie usually means grit, not salt. Dirt and sand in the track grind the rollers, the panel drops, and the latch stops catching. That matters most on pool doors with alarms or self-latching devices. Manufactured homes have their own certified doors, and any replacement needs an HVHZ approval.
faqHeading: Questions about Davie doors, pools and manufactured homes
closing: Send a photo of the door's label and both bottom corners of the panel, or call us, and we'll tell you what kind of door you have and what it needs.

faqs.q: How do I identify the sliding door on my Davie manufactured home?
faqs.a: Look for its certification label. Federal rules in 24 CFR 3280.403 require sliding glass doors in manufactured homes to be certified to AAMA 1701.2 or the North American Fenestration Standard and to carry a label from a certification body. Photograph it and send it with your request.

faqs.q: My Davie pool was approved with door alarms. What happens if I replace the slider?
faqs.a: Plan to put the alarm back on the new door. Exit alarms are one of the pool safety options in Florida Statutes 515.27, rated at least 85 dB A at 10 feet. Ask the town's building division what it expects for your home before the old door comes out.

faqs.q: Why does my Davie slider grind when we live nowhere near the beach?
faqs.a: Grit. Dirt, sand and debris from yards and pool decks collect in the track, mix with old grease and wear down the rollers. Vacuum the track first. If it still grinds with a clean track, the rollers are worn or the rail is scored.

faqs.q: Does a new sliding door in Davie need Miami-Dade approval?
faqs.a: It needs an approval that covers the High-Velocity Hurricane Zone, because Davie is in Broward County. That's usually a Miami-Dade NOA or a Florida product approval marked for HVHZ use. The building division confirms what it accepts with the permit.

faqs.q: Can a manufactured home slider use the same rollers as a house slider?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. Doors built for manufactured homes can differ in panel weight, housing size and track profile from site-built doors. We match the roller to the old one by measurement, since a part that looks right can still sit at the wrong height.
